scope: Scale the exact dated equity V3 target weights into cash using an as-of SPY signal. No selection, security, position, V3 decision, scanner, risk, PAPER, or LIVE change.
hard_boundaries: Do not inspect or consume prior immediate-candidate economic outcomes, results, or reports
Do not run candidate economics in this freeze task
Do not alter V3 rank, selected symbols, target dates, fills, scanner, config, or production code
Do not add securities, short legs, leverage, or positions
Do not use paid data or network data
Do not auto-promote or transfer to PAPER/LIVE

v3_control.evaluation_end_semantics: exclusive UTC boundary; the last eligible V3 session date is 2026-07-29
v3_control.selection_and_weights: Use the control's exact dated target sequence; overlay only multiplies each existing weight by g_d.

scanner.selection_pool_semantics: Reserved SPY plus every candidate passing eligibility filters; alpha ranks the eligible pool and observation capacity is separate.

caps.position_policy: Retain the exact V3 symbol set. If the dated V3 target has more than six simultaneous positions, the shared-capacity acceptance gate is INFEASIBLE; do not truncate or substitute names.

monotonic_cap_proof.premise: For every dated V3 equity weight w_v3[d,s] >= 0 and every candidate scale 0 <= g_d <= 1.
monotonic_cap_proof.equity_weight: w_overlay[d,s] = g_d * w_v3[d,s], therefore 0 <= w_overlay[d,s] <= w_v3[d,s] for every existing symbol.
monotonic_cap_proof.cash: cash_overlay[d] = cash_v3[d] + sum_s((1 - g_d) * w_v3[d,s]); the removed equity exposure becomes cash.
monotonic_cap_proof.crypto_and_other_sleeves: All non-equity V3 sleeves are copied unchanged; no candidate order may reference them.
monotonic_cap_proof.gross_and_positions: Equity gross, combined gross, and active symbol count cannot increase relative to the baseline V3 state; the overlay symbol set is a subset of the dated V3 symbol set.

signal_alignment.as_of_rule: At V3 decision timestamp d, use the latest SPY daily bar timestamp t strictly earlier than d. A bar at d or later is unavailable.
signal_alignment.application_rule: Compute g_d from the as-of bar set and apply the scaled target at the same V3 decision's next eligible equity open, preserving the V3 execution schedule.
signal_alignment.timezone: UTC timestamps from the source; no local-time conversion for ordering
signal_alignment.missing_data_fail_safe: g_d = 0.0 (cash for the managed equity sleeve), with reason recorded; never carry a future value or silently preserve risk.
signal_alignment.warmup_failure: g_d = 0.0 until the candidate's required completed-bar warmup is present and finite.

candidates.formula: g_d = 1 if (C_t > mean(C[t-199:t+1])) and (C_t / max(C[t-251:t+1]) - 1 > -0.10) else 0

reweighting_cost_model.purpose: Model the actual cost of scaling dated V3 targets without rerunning economics in this freeze.
reweighting_cost_model.base_target: For each V3 decision d and existing symbol s, w_overlay[d,s] = g_d * w_v3[d,s]; cash absorbs 1 - sum_s w_overlay[d,s].
reweighting_cost_model.selection_invariance: The symbol set and order of V3 targets are immutable; zero weights do not create positions.
reweighting_cost_model.dated_fills: Replay the canonical dated V3 fill sequence. For each parent fill at decision d, book only g_d times the recorded V3 quantity; never book an unscaled parent fill and a second full-size overlay position.
reweighting_cost_model.marked_overlay_notional: marked_overlay_notional[d,s] = the quantity of the already-held overlay position immediately before d multiplied by the eligible execution reference price at d.
reweighting_cost_model.delta_notional: delta[d,s] = target_notional[d,s] - marked_overlay_notional[d,s]; this is the sole notional submitted as an overlay adjustment order after the scaled parent fill is accounted for.
reweighting_cost_model.execution: Use the recorded V3 fill price/timestamp and the existing execution seam for the scaled parent fills; use the same next-eligible-open, participation, liquidity, slippage, spread, adverse-price, fee, and partial-fill semantics for overlay adjustment orders.
reweighting_cost_model.cost_stress: For multiplier m in {1,2,3}, multiply only the configured slippage_bps and spread_bps by m. Keep commission fixed and apply the effective-dated equity regulatory fee schedule unchanged at each fill date.
reweighting_cost_model.turnover_definition: Report scaled-parent traded notional and overlay-adjustment traded notional separately; each is gross traded notional divided by the lagged overlay NAV, with total turnover their sum.
reweighting_cost_model.unfilled_delta: Unfilled adjustment remains cash and is reported as a fill-capacity failure; no synthetic fill or backfilled price is allowed.
reweighting_cost_model.cash_return_policy: Residual cash earns 0.0 annualized return, compounded daily; no cash-rate observations, future value, or implicit risk asset substitution may be introduced.
reweighting_cost_model.runner_source_requirement: Before any economic run, the research-only runner must be source-pinned to this manifest and validate every source_provenance and component hash; a runner that does not implement the target, marked-holding, delta, and single-booking rules above is blocked.

session_calendar.session_date_rule: Use the first ten characters of each source timestamp as the ISO session date; compare session dates without local-time conversion.
session_calendar.overlay_date_set: Exact intersection of dated V3 NAV/weight state and SPY session dates, restricted to dates less than evaluation_end_exclusive_session_date.

single_use_true_holdout.reuse: one evaluation only; no tuning or rerun after inspection

metric_definitions.daily_CVaR_95: Positive loss magnitude: the negative of the mean of the worst five percent of exact-date daily returns.
metric_definitions.v3_down_day_loss_reduction: 1 - candidate mean absolute negative return divided by V3 mean absolute negative return on the same V3-down dates; an undefined or zero V3 denominator fails the gate.
metric_definitions.annualized_return_opportunity_cost: V3 annualized return minus candidate annualized return, using the same exact window and cost cell.

complement_gates.max_drawdown: candidate <= V3 + 0.01 absolute in every window and cost cell
complement_gates.daily_CVaR_95: candidate <= V3 + 0.01 absolute in every window and cost cell
complement_gates.v3_down_day_loss_reduction: at least 0.05 relative reduction in mean absolute loss on V3-down days, with no worsening of the V3-down-day median loss
complement_gates.return_opportunity_cost: candidate annualized return >= V3 annualized return - 0.03 absolute in every window and cost cell
complement_gates.turnover: overlay turnover and reweighting cost must be reported separately; no hidden cost-free scaling
complement_gates.capacity: combined gross <= 0.60, combined cash >= 0.40, equity gross <= 0.55, and simultaneous total positions <= 6; any violation fails feasibility

block_bootstrap.method: 20-session circular block bootstrap on paired candidate-minus-V3 daily observations

permutation_placebo.method: within-window circular permutation of the frozen SPY signal relative to V3 daily returns
permutation_placebo.purpose: detect whether complement results depend on temporal alignment

multiple_testing.family: five candidates multiplied by the four inferential endpoints max_drawdown, daily_CVaR_95, V3_down_day_loss_reduction, and annualized_return_opportunity_cost; turnover, realized cost, and capacity remain descriptive or hard feasibility gates

evaluation_protocol.promotion: No candidate is eligible for PAPER or LIVE from this protocol alone; require later independent review and a separate transfer gate.

spy_daily_bars.dividend_signal_policy: SPY signal uses split-adjusted close only; cash dividends are not added to the signal series
spy_daily_bars.coverage_note: All five candidates require at most 252 completed SPY sessions; coverage reaches the V3 evaluation end.

environment.worktree: clean before and after the control run

v3_reproduction.mismatch_policy: Any command, environment, source, count, or component mismatch blocks the overlay run.
v3_reproduction.reproduction_note: Final r3 was produced from the exact base commit with the manifest-pinned lifetime dataset; an earlier clean-clone attempt with a different tracked lifetime hash was rejected before acceptance.

excluded_from_inspection: prior immediate-candidate economic outcomes, results, and reports
source_provenance.provenance_rule: Every later runner must validate these hashes and refuse to run on drift.

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, omit manifest_sha256 before hashing
integrity.outcome_access_policy: This freeze contains protocol, source pins, and coverage only. Economic result keys and generated outcome paths are prohibited.
